description.text: This major emphasizes on theoretical and practical study, as well as knowledge application. The methodology of this major focuses on the combination of language surveys and heories both from home and abroad and the combination of Modern Chinese and Ancient Chinese, so that students can be equipped with sound and solid foundation of knowledge. They can keep abreast of the latest achievements and trend in this field and acquire strong teaching and study ability in languages. After graduation, students from this major are welcomed by institutes, colleges, publishing houses and other areas in teaching, researching or editing. Some graduates work on the application of languages in government offices or enterprises. Courses for postgraduates are as follows: Language Theory, Research Methodology of Languages, Selective reading of Famous Linguistic Works, Grammatical Theory, Semantics Theory, Vocabulary Theory, Study on Functional Words, Experimental Phonetics, Phonetics and phonology, History of Chinese, Chinese Phonology, Critical Interpretation of Ancient Chinese Texts, Chinese Dialects and Survey on Dialects, Chinese Characters and so on.

duration.text: The Chinese Characters at Nankai University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3611 USD/per year ￥ 26000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of undergraduate school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3 or above 6. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 7. Study plan Including study purpose, research interest and research plan in brief.

requirements.text: 1. In the age bracket of 22-40 2. Be in good health 3. Holding Bachlor's Degree or equivelance 4. Holding certificate of HSK Level 6 or above 5. Passing the major test and oral Chinese interview held by the applied department 6. Willing to abide by chinese laws, regulations and the school discipline, and respect the chinese people, customs and habits
